BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain floor-tile)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :action-costs)

  (:types robot tile color)

  (:predicates
    (robot-at ?r - robot ?t - tile)
    (robot-has ?r - robot ?c - color)
    (available-color ?c - color)
    (clear ?t - tile)
    (painted ?t - tile ?c - color)
    (up ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    (down ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    (right ?to - tile ?from - tile)
    (left ?to - tile ?from - tile)
  )

  (:functions (total-cost))

  (:action change-color
    :parameters (?r - robot ?old - color ?new - color)
    :precondition (and (robot-has ?r ?old) (available-color ?new))
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-has ?r ?old))
      (robot-has ?r ?new)
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

  (:action paint-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from) (up ?from ?to)
      (robot-has ?r ?c) (clear ?to))
    :effect (and
      (painted ?to ?c)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

  (:action paint-down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from) (down ?from ?to)
      (robot-has ?r ?c) (clear ?to))
    :effect (and
      (painted ?to ?c)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

  (:action move-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and (robot-at ?r ?from) (up ?from ?to) (clear ?to))
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from)) (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from) (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

  (:action move-down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and (robot-at ?r ?from) (down ?from ?to) (clear ?to))
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from)) (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from) (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

  (:action move-right
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and (robot-at ?r ?from) (right ?to ?from) (clear ?to))
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from)) (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from) (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1))
  )

    :effect (and
